Dom Afonso I [ a ] [ b ] (born Afonso Henriques ; 1106/1109/1111 – 6 December 1185) nicknamed " the Conqueror " ( Portuguese : O Conquistador ), " the Founder " ( O Fundador ) [ 2 ] [ 3 ] and " the Great " ( O Magno ) [ 4 ] by the Portuguese , was the first king of Portugal , from 26 July 1139 until his death on 6 December 1185. He achieved the independence of the County of Portugal , establishing a new kingdom and doubling its area with the Reconquista , an objective that he pursued until his death.
